name: save-boot-14c-choice-mktinn-right-down
description: #168 attempt 2 (diagnostic, one of three walk directions). Boot harness/saves/disc1-mktinn.json (Wall Market's inn, field 0xC7; attempt 1 found 5 models, models 1-3 at +PosX and -PosY from the player), load as save-boot-1-load does, mark, hold right + down for 120 frames (toward the NPCs, facing them), then press Circle (hold 2) every 30 frames until window 0's pointerEnabled reads 1 (ptr_wait; a timeout fails the run: no choice reached). Then mark, press Down for 4 frames and wait 12 frames. Reports the player's PosX/PosY direction over the walk (x_dir, y_dir: signs since the load), ptr_y (pointerY after Down: line * 16 + 6), down_dir (sign of its change from Down), win6 (window 0 still in state 6) and match (a rerun from the same snapshot).
